entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We do seem to be inside that door[n]we saw earlier... but why?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just trust me! Wait here and I'll be[n]right back!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's he up to...? I have a really[n]bad feeling about this...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's perfect... Hehehe! This'll totally work!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Uh, Skull...? You have a scary look[n]on your face...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't worry 'bout that. C'mon, let's head[n]back to where that former... noble dude is!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There's nothing else we need to do here,[n]right? C'mon, let's go somewhere else.
